items.text: Cross-functional collaboration with Onto's SW development, SW Quality Assurance and Applications teams to validate software releases for various use-cases across Onto's major customer(s) install base.
Work with cross-functional teams to develop test plans based on customer use-cases for new software releases through the entire SDLC process
Develop efficient test strategies for the different sub-systems comprising the product.
Develop and execute automated and manual tests, regression, functional, and acceptance tests
Investigate, reproduce, log and escalate reported issues/defects
Support full software lifecycle product development for all Onto’s Inspection Business Unit products
Support SW and tool integration efforts in customer clean room
Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science, Computer engineering, Electrical engineering, Systems engineering or related field.
Demonstrated experience in software testing and/or Systems level testing
Good understanding of CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Gitlab, Artifactory, etc
Ability to design and execute test strategies and plans based on requirements and functional designs
Experience working with SQL server and database
Experience working with SEMI-industry AOI tools a plus
